format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: <sf-theme-generator id="t" value="#2e7d32" hue="400" chroma="60" aria-label="Тема сайта"></sf-theme-generator>

probes.title: unset, it is SIMAI Framework's colour: a group named by its title, eight palettes, nothing applied
probes.covers: settings.value, values.theme, accessibility group and name, lang runtime.title, runtime.preview

steps.check: (() => { const g = document.querySelector('#g'); const root = g.querySelector('.sf-theme-generator'); return g.value === '' && root.getAttribute('role') === 'group' && root.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Генератор темы' && g.querySelectorAll('.sf-theme-generator-row').length === 8 && g.querySelector('.sf-theme-generator-preview').getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Предпросмотр темы' && typeof g.theme === 'object' && !document.documentElement.style.getPropertyValue('--sf-primary-40'); })()

probes.title: hue and chroma are numbers: out of range at the edge, unset the colour's own

steps.check: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('#t'); const g = document.querySelector('#g'); return t.hue === 360 && t.chroma === 60 && typeof g.hue === 'number' && typeof g.chroma === 'number' && t.querySelector('.sf-theme-generator').getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Тема сайта'; })()

probes.title: reset answers applied: the browser's change and sf-theme-generator-committed with the theme, the four former names after them
probes.covers: actions.reset, events.change, events.committed, aliases.json sf-theme-generator-change, sf-theme-change, sf-theme-generator-apply, sf-theme-apply
